title: Chapter 122 Goblin
content:
Chapter 122 Goblin

"To be honest, an energy coin of this quality is a priceless treasure wherever it is needed!"

"It is extremely difficult to purify energy ore. The purer the energy, the more difficult it is to refine. Energy coins of this rare quality are difficult to come across in this world!"

"We are lucky enough to meet and have the opportunity to have it. This is God's grace!"

"Thank you Lord Wu Qing and the Zerg for their selfless dedication!"

Hu Wei is knowledgeable and well-informed. He continues to emphasize the value of Zerg energy coins to the lords of the alliance to prevent everyone from being ignorant.

Many alliance lords really don't know this. They just think that this kind of energy currency is very helpful in improving their strength. They didn't expect that there are so many secrets in it.

[Writing this, I hope readers will remember our domain name Taiwan Novel Network→𝗍𝗐𝗄𝖺𝗇.𝖼𝗈𝗆]

After hearing what Hu Wei said, everyone was even more fond of the Zerg energy coins in their hands.

"Lord Hu Wei is right. The energy coins produced by our clan are very valuable for certain occasions."

"But for general applications, if the premium is too high, it is not cost-effective."

"So we still have to treat energy coins as currency, and there is no need to inflate its value."

"The lord believes that the exchange price within our alliance is three times higher than the exchange price in the caravan, so that's about it."

The host conveyed Wu Qing's decision to the lords of the alliance.

Wu Qing wants to popularize Zerg currency. In addition to high quality, the value cannot be too high. Otherwise, ordinary people cannot afford it and there will be no popularization value.

Setting this low price within the league is also his support for the development of the league.

But he somewhat underestimated the people in this world's pursuit of high-quality energy coins. After listening to the host's words, Meng was the first to express his objection.

"Three times is too little! Even if the Zerg wants to support the development of the alliance, the internal exchange price cannot be lower than five times the caravan's usual exchange price!"

With Meng taking the lead, other lords also expressed that the internal exchange price was too low, and everyone deserved it!

"The Lord's request is that it can be up to five times, no higher!"

The host and other alliance lords fully expressed their opinions before speaking out to convey Wu Qing's decision.

"Then set the price five times for now! If the Zerg production is insufficient, this price can be adjusted at any time!"

Meng discussed it with everyone and made this decision.

Under Wu Qing and Meng's singing, they successfully staged a good show of mutual humility within the alliance. The two had not communicated about this in advance. To have such a good effect can be regarded as a true expression of their true feelings.

Wu Qing really wanted to give some benefits to the alliance's territories, because the cost of the Zerg energy coins was very low. Even if it was exchanged at the lowest exchange price given by the caravan, the Zerg could still make a lot of money.

This is mainly because the energy conversion efficiency of the system is too high. If the Zerg produces and recharges a little energy, and exchanges it like a caravan, it can harvest at least a hundred points of system energy, which is already a hundred times huge profit.

Add five times more, which is a huge profit of 500 times. This is still the friendly price within the alliance.

Who wouldn’t want to do this kind of business?

Wu Qing’s idea is that in the early stage, when Zerg energy coins are put into circulation on the market, they will definitely be priced as high as possible. When conditions are mature and it is necessary to fully popularize Zerg currency, the ultra-high premium will be controlled according to the situation. .

…

After some discussion, the alliance took the average price of energy coins exchanged by a caravan and used it as the exchange base for Zerg energy coins. Territory members within the alliance will increase the price by five times on this base for exchange.

The lords of each territory in the alliance made a list of all the things they brought and handed them to the Zerg host. The host will select the materials that can be exchanged based on the requirements of Wu Qing and the Zerg Queen.

Luck beads, energy ores and some special items, materials, and products are the main trading items in various territories and caravans. Wu Qing wants all the luck beads and energy ores. Wu Qing wants those special commodities selectively. Some.

The lords of the alliance are all smart people. They exchange all the things that can be exchanged for Zerg energy coins within the alliance, and only trade with caravans for things that the Zerg don't want.

If the caravan has goods that the territory needs, it can also use Zerg energy coins with higher value outside to buy them. This is equivalent to the Zerg sending a huge benefit to each territory of the alliance. This kind of benefit will continue to be distributed in the future. It depends on each territory of the alliance. How to grasp and balance this advantage.

Meng, Hu Wei, Shi Gan, Yu Chong and Bai Yan were not polite. They dug out all their belongings and exchanged them for Zerg energy coins.

They knew that this was an opportunity given to the alliance by Wu Qing and the Zerg. If they did not make good use of it to develop their territory, they would have failed Wu Qing's expectations.

The exchange speed within the alliance is very fast. Everything has the price of the caravan as a reference, and the value assessment is very simple.

The lords within the alliance have a certain foundation of trust among each other. It doesn't matter if some things have not been shipped for the time being. As long as they promise to deliver the things to Daxia Territory on time, the Zerg host who presides over the exchange will readily pay the Zerg energy coins.

…

Things within the alliance were settled properly, and the person Hu Wei sent to contact the caravan on behalf of the alliance also came back. He brought the person in charge of the caravan and part of the caravan's supplies.

The main body of the caravan is still with the Tengu clan. Their transaction should have been completed and supplies and goods are being delivered to each other. There is no need for the person in charge of the caravan to continue to watch over there.

Meng brought the lord of the alliance to personally welcome the arrival of the caravan. The status of the caravan is very high. Without the caravan, the development of the territory will be severely restricted.

Wu Qing saw the caravan that made him quite curious up close through the host.

The caravan is composed of five huge artificial transport vehicles. This kind of transport vehicle looks a bit like a giant container with eight spider legs under it. If you don't pay attention, you might think it's a big spider carrying a big house.

With the host's detection ability, it can be clearly seen that this is an artificial mechanical creation, and it is the energy ore that drives them to move.

Wu Qing feels that this is a bit like the creation of the Yuanqi civilization he knows.

The people who control these transport vehicles are some green little people who look very similar to bear goblins. Without others introducing them, Wu Qing knows that they are authentic goblins.

The goblin clan is also one of the major clans among the native races in this world. They are good at creation and business. Relying on the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, a super chamber of commerce, their strength is enough to influence the situation of the whole world.

Those transport vehicles are goblin creations, which are one of the most favorite transport vehicles of major chambers of commerce.

They also built many powerful war machines, which were very similar to Wu Qing's impression of the goblins who were good at engineering machinery.
